dungeon.name: Ancient Stone Sarcophagus
dungeon.description: A heavy marble tomb inscribed with forgotten funerary seals. Inspect to search for ancient relics or gold.

dungeon.name: Rusted Weapon Rack
dungeon.description: An old iron rack holding worn blades and polearms. Search to scavenge weapons or crafting metal.

dungeon.name: Ancient Crypt Bookshelf
dungeon.description: A dust-covered oak shelf filled with crumbling spell tomes and historical logs.

dungeon.name: Aged Wine Cask
dungeon.description: A heavy oak barrel sealed with iron bands. Tap the cask to restore HP and stamina.

dungeon.name: Bleached Skeleton Pile
dungeon.description: Scattered remains of past explorers. Search through dust for leftover coins or materials.

dungeon.name: Resonant Mana Crystal
dungeon.description: A glowing azure gem pulsating with elemental energy. Touch to restore MP.

dungeon.name: Thick Arachnid Cobweb
dungeon.description: Dense sticky webbing draped over the wall. Clear away to collect silk threads.

dungeon.name: Forgotten Alchemist Bench
dungeon.description: Vials and glass retorts sitting on a stained stone slab. Search for leftover potions.

ruins.name: Crumbling Sentinel Statue
ruins.description: A weathered statue of a forgotten king. Pray for an ancient blessing and lore.

ruins.name: Overgrown Relic Coffer
ruins.description: A moss-covered brass coffer half-buried in stone ruins. Open to retrieve ancient artifacts.

ruins.name: Weathered Celestial Sundial
ruins.description: An ancient astronomical instrument marking solar movements. Align dial for clarity.

town.name: Feather Bed
town.description: A clean, comfortable bed filled with goose feathers. Rest to fully restore HP and MP.

town.name: Roaring Stone Hearth
town.description: A crackling stone fireplace emitting comforting warmth. Stand nearby to warm up.

town.name: Town Chronicle Bookshelf
town.description: A neatly organized library shelf with town records, maps, and recipe notes.

town.name: Herbalist Flower Pot
town.description: A ceramic pot flourishing with fresh medicinal herbs. Harvest for alchemy ingredients.

town.name: Town Stone Well
town.description: A deep stone well fed by underground mountain springs. Drink to restore MP & stamina.

town.name: Bounty & News Notice Board
town.description: A wooden board pinned with regional trade notices and monster rumors.

town.name: Tavern Feast Table
town.description: A long oak dining table laden with fresh bread, cheese, and roasted meats.
